verified_facts.text: The hotel is steps from the BTS Skytrain Ratchathewi station and within walking distance of the Siam shopping district.
verified_facts.excerpt: is just steps away from the BTS Skytrain Ratchathewi station and within walking distance of the city’s most famous shopping district Siam

verified_facts.text: The hotel was designed by French architect J + H Boiffils, with works of art, exotic furniture, soft shades and bold colors.
verified_facts.excerpt: creation of renowned French architect J + H Boiffils, with a spellbinding atmosphere and complete with works of art, exotic furniture, soft shades and audacious colors

verified_facts.text: Rooms and suites have high ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows with views across the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: high ceiling and spacious rooms and suites, each providing dramatic views across an inspiring cityscape with its floor-to-ceiling windows

verified_facts.text: Asian design accents feature in the rooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Intriguing Asian design accents create a refined and relaxed ambience for discerning guests.

verified_facts.text: The rooftop infinity pool has a glass screen at its end, so guests feel as though they are swimming towards the horizon.
verified_facts.excerpt: the infinity pool, which extends to the very front of the YTSB building with its glass screen at the end allowing guests to feel as though they are swimming towards the beautiful horizon

verified_facts.text: At dusk, poolside tables and chairs at The Edge Pool Bar let guests watch the sunset over a cocktail.
verified_facts.excerpt: As dusk falls, the sun loungers are augmented with poolside tables and chairs allowing guests to watch the sunset whilst relaxing over a post dip cocktail.

verified_facts.text: VIE Spa's signature treatment is the Aromatic Candle Massage.
verified_facts.excerpt: Don’t forget to try our signature Aromatic Candle Massage

verified_facts.text: VIE Spa is built around a journey through the world of scents.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treat yourself to a journey through the world of scents

verified_facts.text: Piano Bar has Art Deco interiors, lounge seating and jazz.
verified_facts.excerpt: Piano Bar features elegant Art Deco interiors, comfortable lounge seating and  jazz accompaniments.

verified_facts.text: La VIE Bistronomy is a casual all-day dining venue on the 11th floor.
verified_facts.excerpt: friendly and casual all-day dining venue

verified_facts.text: The hotel is near the Airport Rail Link, making it easy to travel between the airport and the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Visitors can easily commute between the airport and the city as the hotel is located near the Airport Rail Link.

verified_facts.text: Jim Thompson House is among the attractions near the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: This includes the exquisite antiques and classic Thai architecture of the Jim Thompson House

verified_facts.text: Siam Square is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: just 10 minutes’ walk from the city’s premier shopping district at Siam Square

verified_facts.text: The hotel is LGBTQ+ friendly and family-friendly.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel is also both LGBTQ+ and family-friendly, suitable for all ages.
VIE Hotel Bangkok – MGallery Collection is a non-smoking hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has a fitness room.
verified_facts.excerpt: Additionally, a fitness room and spacious rooms for meetings are also offered.

verified_facts.text: The decor mixes luxury and minimalism.
verified_facts.excerpt: The décor offers a mix of luxury and minimalism, making the big spaces feel small and the small spaces feel beautiful.

verified_facts.text: The function rooms have modern designs and natural light.
verified_facts.excerpt: VIE function rooms are dedicated and private with elegant modern designs and welcoming natural light
